probing_questions: Which named works or thinkers are invoked in the argument, and which are only listed in the references?
What proposition is assigned to each selected source, and who is making that attribution?
How is each citation used here: as support, criticism, method, example or background?
Which references are grouped or opposed by the supplied text, and on what shared question?
Where does the passage confer authority, acknowledge a debt or leave a possible allusion uncertain?

problematique: A selective citation-use register (citing passage, cited work, attributed proposition, use, access) and an engagement table distinguishing support, criticism, background and uncertain allusion; explain the consequential citation pattern without certifying fidelity to unsupplied works. One text with references or a supplied set of citing texts; access to cited texts is optional and separately recorded.
researcher_question: How do the supplied works cite one another and use those citations?
